parent_contract.note: inherits unchanged: pilot geometry/centres, kernel definition, group-balanced norm, precision tolerances, provisional/final selection rule shape, and the six paired nominal/duplicate branches (already run; not resubmitted)

reason.finding: Theta had no passing candidate at alpha in {0.025,0.05,0.10}: both S1 Theta directions (day720 eastern, day3600 northern) failed Q_lin at every candidate (0.38-0.54 vs the 0.05 threshold), while S0/S2 Theta passed cleanly at every candidate.
reason.diagnosis: S1's local (regime-only) standard deviation at those two cells/channels is 0.056x and 0.064x the pooled (S0+S1+S2) normalizer sigma used to build the unit-RMS direction -- by far the smallest ratio of any Theta direction (next smallest: S2 southern at 0.271x). The pooled sigma there is dominated by S0/S2's stronger wind forcing, not S1's own (weakest, 0.75x) circulation, so a nominally 'unit RMS' perturbation is a much larger perturbation relative to what S1 actually varies by at those specific locations. Verified directly against trajectories_v3: only wind-stress amplitude differs across regimes, confirming this is a normalization-basis effect, not a data or pipeline bug.
reason.action_per_section_22_gate_d2: no passing candidate requires a separately versioned pilot contract with smaller candidate amplitudes; this file is that contract, scoped to the Theta family only.

candidate_alpha_derivation: targets bringing S1's local-relative perturbation back toward the same order as S0/S2's smallest passing case: alpha * (pooled_sigma/local_std) ~= 0.025 * 0.886 ~= 0.022 for S0's best case; solving alpha ~= 0.022 * 0.056 ~= 0.0012 for S1's worst ratio motivates probing a decade below the v1 grid (0.001-0.01, bracketing the ~0.0012 estimate) instead of reusing 0.0025 (which loses precision under the existing 3-decimal alpha-token filesystem naming)
